gift_of_the_magi.note: Poverty + pride + hair sale + chain for the watch: she sacrifices her pride to dignify his. Spans P1-P3.
Gift as recognition of who Jim is. Close to the narrator's explicit 'It was like him'; 'rather than mere expenditure' adds little.
Extends c02_1 with Della's fear of no longer being pretty. Supported by the prayer, but 'inseparable' overclaims.
The stare reread + the prayer answered by 'love unchanged': devotion separated from appearance. Spans P4-P5.
Mutual sacrifice, both gifts useless, declared wisest. 5 contributors across P3 and P6; extends c02_1. Labelled 'explicit' although only the 'wisest' judgement is explicit.

plato_cave.note: Liberation as painful, staged retraining. Largely a summary of P2-P3; 'alone makes' overclaims.
Return inverts the value of the ascent: on the cave's own terms, enlightenment defeats itself.
The sun as an effect of the Good: the visible world is doubly derivative (P3 + P4).
Two kinds of dazzle, to be diagnosed rather than mocked. Mostly P5's explicit principle; adds P2's glare as an instance.
Unwillingness as happiness, not arrogance. 'Not arrogance' is a framing no unit supports; the rest is supported.
The painful turning in the cave (P1-P2) reread through education as turning an existing sight (P6).
Fixation on shadows and contemplative withdrawal as two symmetric disqualifications, cured by compelled descent (P1, P5, P7).
The same keenness serves evil or truth depending on direction. Nearly stated by P7's 'very same faculty'.
Reluctance becomes the credential of the best rulers (P5 + P8).
The returner's ridiculed blindness (P4) reread as learnable night-vision that fits him to rule (P8).
Reluctance becomes acceptance through the shared heavenly life. Mostly P9's explicit argument; 'willing acceptance' is softer than the text's 'stern necessity'.
All four contributors come from P9 and restate its explicit argument. Not cross-passage.
